info.title: OMS Transfer Service
info.description:
This API is used to transfer objects and tasks between environments. It is often better to use the 'transfer wizard' if it is available.

## Terminology
* Transfer is the general name for this service.
* Checkout or Pull refers to a transfer that copies to the development environment. Action is Checkout. 
* Promote or Push refers to a transfer that moves to a higher environment. Action is Promote
* Move and Copy refer to a guided transfer that lets the user select a from and target environment and also define the action; Action is Move or Copy

## Workflow

### Select
1. Use the 'selectRequest' schema to define a /select call. The selectRequest schema contains the action, application and taskNumber as required parameters, an optional from environment in case the from environment is known, and an optional object list in case individual objects must be passed instead of all objects in the task. 

2. The selectRequest receives a 'targets' schema containing an array of 'target'. If there is one 'target' object, the 'Prepare' workflow step can be started, otherwise the user has to select a 'target'.

### Prepare
1. Use the 'prepareRequest' schema to define a /prepare call. If a 409 response is received then the database service must be queried on table OMPTT with the received temporary transfer number from the 'prepareResponse' schema. Table OMPTC contains the header of the OMPTT records. The user must be informed about the contents of OMPTT/OMPTC and confirm it. 

2. After receiving a 200 or a 409 response, the transfer is prepared in the OMOW3 table which can be queried with the database service with the transferNumer to see the result of the prepare. To see the subenvironment description, table OMLBL can be queried with information from OMOW3 with applicationCode, environmentCode=toProductionLevel, and sequenceNumber=toLibrarylistSeq. The 'addressDetails' schema contains the physical taget machines that are part of this deployment. Each target lists the valid selectable job descriptions in case the user wants to override this. 

### Execute
After confirmation, the 'executeRequest' schema can be filled to call /execute. The 'executeResponse' will contain the final transferNumber and the job information that processes the transfer. The job information and the transferNumber can be used to check the status of the request.

### Progress
After executing the request, the /progress path can be called to see the status of the transfer and possible remote deployments.

### Cancel
If the user wants to cancel the transfer, this can be done before the /execute path is called. To clean up workfiles and resources, the /cancel path must be called.

endOfProcessing.description: Closes the underlying API after calling. Keep open with '0' if you have to call the API in quick succession. Make sure to close on the last call with '1'

updateDb.description: Specify '1' to update the database or '0' to not update but check only.

updateBuffer.description: Specify '1' to update the returned data with the latest values or '0' to not return the latest task data.

extendedMessage.description: It contains all the error messages returned by the API.

status.description:
This status will return following values based on validations.    
*NORM - If object can be processed without any error or warning.     
*CONF- If object has encountered some warning.     
*TERM - If object cannot be processed.

messageTextExtended.description: It contains the additional message information based on the value of the request.

objects.description: A list of objects which can be empty.

targetSubEnvironments.description: A list of target subenvironments which can be empty.

confirmation.description: Pre transfer check confirmation requested. Set to true.

fromEnvironmentDescription.description: The descripion of the from environment for information purposes.

toEnvironmentDescription.description: The descripion of the target environment for information purposes.

isDefault.description: Indicates if the environment must be preselected.

subEnvironments.description: The subenvironments that are part of this transfer. This is represented by the OMLBL table in the database service.

fixedNumberofSubEnvironments.description: If > 0 then this number of sub-environments must be selected. If 0 then the user may decide how many sub-environments are selected. If -1 then there is no selection required on sub-environments.

status.description:
You can use the Status option to disable    
this target or to mark it as a branching    
template.                                   
                                            
0=Active                                    
    The sub-environment is used normaly when
    transfering objects.                    

 1=Disabled                              
     The sub-environment is not used when
     transfering objects.                
                                         
 2=Template                              
     The sub-environment is a branching  
     template.

jobDescriptionCode.description: It contains the job description code.

description.description: Description contains an explanation of the job description.

jobDescriptionLibrary.description: It contains the job description library.

queuePriority.description:
The Queue priority indicator indicates the priority of the job to be submitted using 
this job description.    
                 
0 = *NORMAL - The job priority will be normal.     
1 = *HIGH - The job priority will be high.

defaultJobDesc.description:
The Default indicator is used to make the default job description.

0 = No   - The job description is not the default.
1 = Yes -  The job description will be the default.

objectList.description:
List of Objects for select.
If all objects in the task need to be selected, the Object List should be left blank.
If only some of the objects in the task need to be selected, the Object Code and its Type should be listed in the Object List.

schedules.description: The transfer schedule override information per target or empty to take the defaults.

addressDetails.description: It contains the address and job description details.

jobDescriptions.description: It contains the job description informations.

address.description: The address information which is '**LOCAL' for the local address and the address name for remote addresses.

scheduleDate.description: The schedule date is used in an Object Transfer function to enter the date the Object Transfer job has to be scheduled for. The date must be entered in user format.  Use *IMMED if a schedule date is not required.

scheduleTime.description: The schedule time is used in an Object Transfer function to enter the time the Object Transfer job has to be scheduled for. This is HHMMSS format. Use *IMMED if a schedule time is not required.

holdJob.description: Indicate whether the job must be held for managed deployments.

isJobRunning.description: Return true if the job is currently active; otherwise, return false.

objects.description: How many objects are in the transfer.

objectsProcessed.description: Return How many objects are processed.

objectsSucceeded.description: The number of objects successfully transferred.

objectsFailed.description: The number of objects that failed to transfer.

deployed.description: Return the number of machines distributed.

inProgress.description: Return the number of  deployments are inprogress.

failed.description: Return the number of deployements are failed..

success.description: Return the number deployements are success.

deployment.description: Return the distribution details like how many machines are distributed, how many machines are success/in progress/fail

The objects from environment *ACC can not leave for environment *PRD until all objects have passed the ratification level of environment *ACC after the fix has been ratified by authorized staff. &N Recovery  . . . :   Do as indicated and try your request again.
